contract: A recurring creative commission is a typed standing brief with a supported ability, canonical direction sources, bounded deterministic plan, provider-neutral canonical dispatch configuration, current cadence and retry budget. The shared TriggerStore remains the only clock authority. Every occurrence has one deterministic run identity and one idempotently linked DirectionStore project; upstream media, music, music-video or series-production admission receipts, attempts, failures and immutable output references remain durable. Feedback is an author-separated revisioned reaction keyed to an actual commission/run/output identity and only a bounded live window is supplied as data to later direction projects.
acceptance: Create validates video, image, music, music-video or series ability, typed intent/style/constraints/seeds, canonical work or series sources, a bounded direction plan and daily, weekly, custom cron, interval or guarded calendar recurrence cadence. It writes one deterministic shared clock trigger and surfaces trigger persistence failure instead of claiming the schedule is armed.

A real due TriggerStore fire dispatches the commission action provider. The provider rereads enabled state, schedule revision and cadence hash before work, so disabling or changing a commission before a stale tick creates no project or run.

Each occurrence creates at most one idempotent DirectionStore project, executes its bounded non-generation plan through real direction operations and records exact project/output artifact/version/hash links. Calendar recurrences preserve authored local wall time across daylight-saving changes, honor exclusions and finite bounds, and rearm the same shared one-shot trigger after a real success or failure. Repeated delivery returns the same completed run; failures retain bounded classifications and retry attempts until exhausted.

When dispatch is configured, image and video use canonical MediaJobs generation operations, music uses the configured MusicGeneration job service, music-video uses its pinned local render project, and series uses the approval-gated SeriesProductionStore. Each commission attempt has a deterministic upstream request ID and durable normalized receipt; queued work is reported as submitted, while absent configuration, provider or renderer is external_unavailable and remains retryable without fabricated output.

Restart preserves commission, trigger, run attempts, linked project and outputs. Manual HTTP and native tool runs use the same execution path and do not accept provider, model, credential, home or runtime overrides.

A feedback reaction resolves an actual linked output and is isolated by author. Rerating increments the same deterministic record, deletion leaves a tombstone, another author's reaction is unchanged, and later runs pin the revisions of only the bounded live feedback they consumed.
limits: Provider-backed output is produced only by the configured canonical job or production service. A submitted receipt is admission evidence and never claims that media or manuscript output completed.
Peer propagation of reaction records is deferred to the sharing slice; local author isolation, revision lineage and tombstones are implemented here.
Root integration must register the unique HTTP handler, console route, native tool provider and creative-commission trigger action provider.
